name: poke-suite
description: Two cooperating Airtable interfaces: Poke Kanban and Poke Mart

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix apps/poke-kanban && npm ci --prefix apps/poke-mart
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/poke-kanban && npm run lint --prefix apps/poke-mart
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/poke-kanban && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/poke-mart
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
